text:
Fixed the autoescape context leak in scoped `{% autoescape %}` blocks.

Root cause: the compiler saved the runtime evaluation context but never restored it after rendering the block. Added the corresponding `context.eval_ctx.revert(...)` call.

Tests: `114 passed`.

final_text:
Fixed the autoescape context leak in scoped `{% autoescape %}` blocks.

Root cause: the compiler saved the runtime evaluation context but never restored it after rendering the block. Added the corresponding `context.eval_ctx.revert(...)` call.

Tests: `114 passed`.
